text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: x shares y with someone.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(x) ::: x is Karen.
BlackMirror ::: "Black Mirror".
StrangerThings ::: "Stranger Things".
Premises:
∀x (Popular(x) ∧ NetflixShow(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Download(x, Karen)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download(BlackMirror, Karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
NetflixShow(BlackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Share(x, Lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Share(StrangerThings, Lisa) ::: Karen will share "Stranger Things" with Lisa.
